changelog: App Base Update: Updated app base to 439.0.0.37.89 for better stability and latest features.
Highest refresh: Added your device highest display refresh rate for smooth scrolling in liquid bar
Story Bug Fixed : In Previous update Story are not uploading now it is fixed
Liquid Glass Tab Bar: Added a new Liquid Glass Bottom Tab Bar (beta stage) for a modern look.
Liquid Glass Customisation: Personalize the Liquid Glass appearance to match your style.
Android Compatibility: Liquid Glass is available on Android 13 and above only.
Call Recording: Added Call Recording support for audio calls.
Custom Story Audio: Pick any audio or music directly from your local storage for stories.
Online Toast: Get a popup notification when your friend comes online.
Follow Indicator: See who follows you directly in Followers and Following lists without opening profiles.
Advanced Story Fonts: Added Advanced Custom Story Fonts for more creative stories.
Bulk Font Download: Download multiple story fonts at once with Bulk Font Download.
Saved Copies: Check your copied bios, comments, captions, and more from Quick Menu and Settings.
New Settings Design: Added a redesigned InstaFuse Settings interface.
Settings Search: Quickly find any InstaFuse setting with the new search option.
Experimental Settings: Added Experimental Settings for testing upcoming features.
